dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Nod-Krai is close to the sea, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Smoked Fish Steak</color> has been a staple here for ages. All the old folks know how to make it.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: It's not a taste you'd ever forget once you've had it. *sigh* I wish I could've tried it one more time...
